::: {.callout-tip}
## Why This Matters
Ahmedabad firm (founder Nikul Shah) that entered through certified RF/IoT modules (15+ certified, about 60,000 units shipped in a year) to fund a push toward its own low-cost RISC-V SoC aimed at the ultra-cheap chip segment India imports from China. Bootstrapped; signed an OSAT collaboration MoU with Kaynes Semicon in April 2026.
:::

## What does this firm design?

Certified BLE, Wi-Fi, LoRa, GNSS and Zigbee modules and SiPs; the ISC-VEGA-SOM module built on C-DAC's VEGA Thejas32 processor; and a first in-house 32-bit RISC-V MCU at prototype stage.
